shader:domain-warp.title: domain-warp
shader:domain-warp.summary: Organic noise-based warp with glowing edge
requires: literal colours (no var()) and explicit scene background-color
no 'transparent' in gradients
HyperShader owns scene visibility
scenes overlap during the transition window
shader:domain-warp.cost: slow: Node-side layered render, several seconds per frame on 2-core software GL

verified.environment: cloud Linux container, 2 cores, 8 GB, SwiftShader software GL, headless-shell 141, hyperframes 0.8.114
verified.evidence: Sampler of all 14 shaders at 1080x1920. Default render path: HyperShader falls back to opacity-flip = hard cuts (page-side compositing needs drawElementImage, absent in headless-shell 141). HF_PAGE_SIDE_COMPOSITING=false (Node-side layered path): effects render but the scene textures are black, so every transition flashes black; 270 frames took 13m55s. Not verified on a Mac with a real GPU.

requires: scenes overlap during the transition window
outgoing scene fully visible when it starts (no exit animation before it)

findings.finding: In headless-shell without drawElementImage, HyperShader silently degrades to hard cuts; the Node-side layered path blends effects over black scene textures. Treat shader transitions as untested until a Mac render proves them; never rely on them for a deadline.
Giving each scene an opaque background hides any shared overlay that has no z-index (the caption layer vanished). Raise shared layers (captions, progress, brand marks) above the scenes.

Six unrelated backdrop colours passed Rule A but the independent critic called it 'six templates from one pack' (continuity 6 vs 9). One colour family varied by tier/structure also passed Rule A (5 of 6 distinct) and was preferred. Pick backdrops from one palette/preset family.
CSS transitions overlap two scenes; hyperframes check raises content_overlap warnings for text-over-text (blur crossfade). Mark the window with data-layout-allow-overlap. Push-slide raised none.

Rule B reads the signature from #root CSS; once scenes carry their own backdrops it is stale (flagged a different-looking video as a duplicate of pilot-001). Compute the signature from the opening scene or the measured scene backdrops before relying on Rule B with per-scene backdrops.
hyperframes lint reports missing_timeline_registry for HyperShader.init compositions unless window.__timelines[id] is assigned explicitly.
Frame presets assume web fonts (Barlow, Playfair, Bodoni...); vendor them into assets/ (hyperframes-localize-fonts) before a render, as our pipeline renders offline.
